categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the calculation of a special allowance for workers, which is done under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. The core content is a regulatory action—publishing a statutory instrument (a notification) that determines a legally binding rate for worker allowances based on a prescribed formula. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which includes "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While a government official is named, the notice is about implementing a regulation, not about the official's appointment, portfolio, or a change in government structure. Therefore, the specialized legal/regulatory classification takes precedence.

description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 02.11.2015 to 08.11.2015

description: Uva Province - Appointed Mrs. G. A. M. S. P. Ambanwela, Mr. L. L. Anil Wijesiri, Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda and Mr. G. K. S. L. categorisation: The gazette content primarily consists of personnel appointments (naming specific individuals like Mrs. G. A. M. S. P. While it mentions ministry names, it does NOT include detailed portfolio responsibilities or subject matter descriptions for these individuals - only their basic titles and assigned ministries. This fits Type 2 (People Gazette) as it focuses on government personnel changes without detailed portfolio responsibilities.

description: Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation - The Motor Traffic (Driving Schools Driving Instructors and Assistant Driving Instructors) Regulations No. 01 of 2015

It creates a regulatory framework with specific compliance requirements, licensing procedures, and operational standards, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, and the primary content is regulatory rather than governmental personnel or structural changes.

description: Eastern Province - Appointed Hon. Ahamed Lebbe Mohamed Nazeer as the Provincial Minister of Health, Indigenous Medicine etc., with effect from 26.10.2015

description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Order to approve the acquisition of the immovable properties in D/S Division Kataragama, Kataragama, Monaragala District for the constructions under Kataragama Sewerage Project and in Karasnagala, Attanagalla D/S Division Gampaha District for the constructions under Gampaha Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Project and in Godella, D/S Division Buttala, Monaragala District for the constructions under Monaragala Buttala Integrated Water Supply Project
